Keep: FreshIdle admitting or reopening an unconsumed pending latest key
native_watermark_commit.rule: FreshIdle means latest key above the committed consumed watermark, possibly received earlier but still pending complete history/refs. It does not require re-receiving that key. PreparedC1Event binds Keep/Advance; after generated success apply that prevalidated choice infallibly. NewEpoch preserves actual keys. Generated error never advances.

funding_pending_whole_map_rule: fundingPending means ANY retained boundary with receipt=None, including zero-quantity or economically flat late cash. RecordFundingSettled is emitted only when the ENTIRE actual CarryEngine funding map has no unpaid boundary, not once per received payment. Only then may a later verified AllSettledIdle event grant idle state.

source_gap_and_pending_rule.Pending: Not-yet-available input preserves arming and consumed watermark. FreshIdle/DisableIdle keep the evaluation pending; EnableIdle does not arm.
source_gap_and_pending_rule.GapOrQuarantinedWhileIdle: A genuine admitted source discontinuity invalidates the prior episode's arming. Prepare RequestEpoch and NewEpoch only after actual healthy fully settled idle is verified, then DisableIdle. Keep all actual keys, wallet/financial identity maps and latches. No prior consumed key becomes Fresh.
source_gap_and_pending_rule.ActiveGap: Missing indispensable active context is technical Stop, not an idle disable or an epoch reset.
source_gap_and_pending_rule.policy_epoch: Same guarded RequestEpoch/NewEpoch sequence handles prospective selected-fold activation. Stopped cannot reset; Busy/Reserved must defer. Temporary Disabled stays Disabled until current input is valid.
